content: 25:1-13 Yamangar yorou 10-ende
Ne mi geret big qamar: “Qen end Qenu wonou ginamt bibis igo eng yamangar yorou 10-ende munon ger irub se baub wogub yara qataben is gab mot yarub qamb urut uruguni baub isub igour gas ende.
Ne yamangar 10 eng 5-ende wuri tagug, ne bo 5-ende eng wuri misirnob.
Yamangar 5 tagug eng wuri urut gari-gari mor end uruguni qas ba isumirei, ui ar ger me baiau.
Ne yamangar 5 misirnob eng wuri urut uruguni ba ne ui ar gor ba isumirei.
Isub munon eng sobor me diara qoat-qoat igoi wogub mungam igara inemirei.
Mit big qob. Yamangar yorou 10-ende.
Itum wobon end igumir eng ete qamb amirei: ‘munon yamangar se baiar eng di igo. Isub gab mot diarar.’
Ende igub gugum der bugab urut uruguniamirei. Ne yamangar 5 tagug eng der qei misirnob eng wurinob qamamir: ‘An urut qei indarar, in urut araret uburai.’
Ende qamarari misirnob eng der tagug eng wurinob qamamir, ‘in urut ininou qeemben gari, ui ger igama gab me andarunei. End ne aninou bo isub urut wes gab suab urugunimar.’
Ende qamarari wuri bo urut umau suoub qamb isari munon eng diara yamangar 5 misirnob tug igour eng mot mor isub mondir nausi ubet wogub bugab mi nub igurei.

Ne yamangar 5 urut baub qamb isumir eng bo qanamt yar ag irot igo qamamir, ‘barai, in gor mondir weimatara diorub,’ qamamir e munon eng taui qamar: ‘apand aninob quraum, ye an sir ue end mondir me weimatarinei.’
Qob eng igub ne an mom qoyametarar. Qen eng yariner eng an sir ue end.”
25:14-30 Sarau munon ombur gari
Ne bo qamar: “Munon aib ger ai pa qoaib qamb ne wonou sarau munon wurit qamara yarari wonomi eng qerei gari-gari qoat igoarar qamb wogub qorei.

Wonou sarau munon wurinou misir ne qomon ne qer gagam eng imbig ne mi qeemben ende wurit wogub qorei. Geret nomon qur qangang K5,000-ende uterei, ne ger K2,000-ende ne ger K1,000-ende wurit qerei wogub isorei.
Isa wogub munon K5,000 bauor eng qand isub nomon qur end sarau ebet bo ui ar K5,000-ende baurei.
Ne bo munon K2,000 bauor eng gor nomon qur end sarau ebet bo ui ar K2,000-ende baurei.
Ne munon nomon qur K1,000 bauor eng bisub tumun goanet wogub wonou munon barai nomon qur eng tumunimetet wagerei.
Togun irou uma wogub wurinou munon barai eng yarerei. Yarab nomon qur wurisab wogub isuor eng mai ebetemirei qi eng gib qamb wuriqiumuniamorei.

Ne munon K5,000 utab wogub isuor eng sarau ebet wogub bo imusi K5,000 bauor eng ba yarab sirbig qamar: ‘Barai, ne K5,000 yasab wogub iuan eng ye bo nomon qur end sarau ebet imusi bo K5,000 baum e ge.’
Ende qamara wonou munon barai taui qamar: ‘Sig uber ebetenei, ne sarau munon qangiri uber. End ne mi ye nemaribigine mi irou qoat igoriban. End ne ne yara yenob uberet igorun.’
Ne bo munon K2,000 bauor eng bo sarau ebet imusi bo K2,000 bauor eng ba diab wonou munon barai sirbig qamar, ‘E ge, ne K2,000 yeisen eng ye bo sarau ebet bo ui ar K2,000 baum eng e.’
Qamara wonou munon barai qamar: ‘Ne sarau munon uber end mi qomourt eng bo nonou aba aib burer end ne nemaribigine mi irou qoat igoriban. End yara yenob mismisir igorun.’
Ne bo sasam munon K1,000 wot wager eng diab qamar: ‘Barai, ne munon qand mirinet ne munon mani ubari arira ne wurit baub ne munon mi gonari qaur di arira wurit baub igama negab igoum.
End nenet yari wogub nonou nomon qur eng ye tumuni wagom eng e igo e.’
Ende qamara wonou munon barai taui qamar: ‘Ne sarau munon boru irigau qoat. Ye eret munon wurinou mani qamb nanasingir qamb baine yegab igoanei?
Ende gab ne meimet qamb yonou nomon qur bisub nomon qur qirinau big igour munai end big igama ye ete yarab nomon qur ui qei baiau ue?
Ende ne munon eng nomon qur K1,000-end wot ba munon nomon qur K10,000 igo eng utari sorieminer.
End ne munon ger mi irou igoriner eng ye bo sembigi utibam. A munon ger mi ios ete igoriner eng ye bo wot baine ar igoriba.
Sarau munon boru tagug eng an toat ariramari is ag irond igo eab nan suab igoriner.”
25:31-46 Qen sasam qereiminer eng
Qen end Munangit wau bo igeser deriner eng munon barai aib deriba. Dara wonou munon yurau enger nob darab wo nam qab qenenginob end bugemba.
Bugab igama munon ag e gugum wo menmant end yar nagari wuriboopur yurau ombur ariramba. Munon wai sipsip meme nob oroar igo bubur qerei sipsip wes wuri ariri a gout wes wuri arir igo gas ende ebeiba.
Wai sipsip uberegent wes end bigiba a meme uben qagit wes end bigiba.
Ende at Munon aib munon yurau uberegent wes eng wurinob qemeriba: ‘An munon yurau eng yonou Tain annonogursi igoar end e yarar. Yarab qoan ai big-big bibis et igoarar qamb anit iyeter end igoarar.
Ye minemb igimine mani yasari nub igumei. Yat ebet igimine yasab igumonei. Ne ye munon bubun animbegeib isine munai yiimbigari inab igumei.
Mi goan ue gab qoot ebine mi goan yasab igumanei. Toar yenara yemusub igumanei, a uyort igimine yar yegab igumanei.’
Ende qamara munon qoregen eng taui qomorubour: ‘Barai, qen mait ne minemb igama mi neteminei? qo yat ebet igama neteminei?
Qo munon bubun yara negab munai neteminei? qo ararau igama mi goan neteminei?
Qo qen mait toar qiyo uyort igama is negab igunei?’
Ende qamarari Munon barai taui wurinob qamar: ‘Apand aninob quraum, munon boru ag e ende wuri musub igoumon eng ye yemusub igumanei.’

Ne bo munon uben qagit igorunor eng wurinob qemeriba: ‘An munon boru Qenut qob isi wot qamb igoumon eng ye qani me igoarar. Mut qenen oab igo eng yonou Tain Qenu Satan wonou munon yurau enger wurit arsiarerei.
An ye minemb igimine mani me yesau, yat ebet igimine ya me yesari niau.
Qunan animbegeib isum eng munai ger yiimbigari me inau. Ne ararau igimine mi goan me yasau, ne gor, toar qiyo uyort igimine an me yemusub igamau.’
Ende qamara wuri der taui qomorubour: ‘Barai, qen mait ne minemb qiyo, a yat ebet qiyo, a qunan inimbegeib qiyo, a ararau igama qiyo, a toar qiyo uyort igama me nemusub igamau?’
Ne Munon aib taui wurinob qemeriba: ‘Apand aninob quraum, munon boru ger ye mi eng gagar quraum eng an mag gari ibag wogub igoumon eng ye mag gari yegab wogub igumanei.
End ne munon yurau eng qenen migeri igab igoriba. A munon qoregen wuri qenen bebereg igorubour.”
